info.title: WealthWise API
info.description: Robo-Advisory & Portfolio Recommendation Platform (BC-AINE-008). Machine-readable companion to specs/design/api-contracts.md. Money and percentage values are transported as fixed-scale decimal STRINGS, never JSON numbers, per NFR-01. No endpoint is rate limited (out of scope per BRD 5.2).

get.description: Public. Returns 200 within 1 second of successful startup (NFR-07). Story E1-S4.

post.summary: Authenticate and receive a JWT access token
post.description: Public. Single 60-minute access token, no refresh flow. Story E2-S2.

401.description: Invalid credentials - unknown email and wrong password are indistinguishable (E2-S1 AC2)

error.message: Invalid email or password.

get.description: Any authenticated role. Used by the SPA to restore a session after page refresh (E2-S3 AC5).

get.summary: Active questionnaire for the customer to answer
get.description: Customer role only. Option point values are deliberately omitted. Stories E4-S3, E4-S4.

questions.text: What is your investment time horizon?

post.summary: Submit questionnaire answers and receive a deterministic risk band
post.description: Customer role only. Append-only: inserts RiskProfileAnswer rows plus a new RiskBandAssignment and one AuditLogEntry. Stories E4-S2, E4-S3. AC-01.

422.description: Incomplete or invalid answer set - nothing is written (E4-S3 AC2)

error.message: All questions must be answered.

get.summary: Most recent risk-band assignment for the authenticated customer
get.description: Customer role only. Story E4-S3 AC4.

404.description: No risk-band assignment exists for this customer

error.message: No risk band has been assigned yet.

get.summary: Recommended asset allocation for the authenticated customer
get.description: Customer role only. Percentages always sum to exactly 100 (AC-02). Response carries template_version for AC-10 traceability. Stories E5-S2, E5-S3.

parameters.name: goal_id
parameters.description: Select the horizon from a specific goal. Omitted: the highest-priority goal supplies the horizon; with no goals, horizon defaults to MEDIUM.

404.description: No risk-band assignment, unknown goal, or no active template. No fallback allocation is returned (E5-S3 AC2).

error.message: Complete the risk-profile questionnaire first.

get.description: Customer role only. Drift is computed on read, never stored. Zero holdings returns 200 with an empty list (E6-S4 AC5). Stories E6-S3, E6-S4. AC-05.
Customer role only. Returns only this customer's goals; no parameter can widen the scope (E7-S4 AC3). AC-03.

200.description: Goals ordered by priority then target_date

post.description: Customer role only. customer_id comes from the token. Stories E7-S2, E7-S4. AC-03.

422.description: target_amount <= 0, target_date in the past, or priority out of range

error.message: target_amount must be greater than zero.

patch.description: Customer role only. created_at is never altered (E7-S2 AC4). Another customer's goal returns 404 (E7-S2 AC5).

get.summary: Ordered GoalProgressSnapshot history for a goal
get.description: Customer role only. Append-only history, oldest first. Stories E7-S3, E7-S4. AC-08.

get.summary: List the authenticated customer's rebalancing recommendations
get.description: Customer role only. Defaults to status=pending. Story E8-S3 AC1. AC-06.

parameters.name: recommendation_id
parameters.description: Public UUID identifier, not the internal row id.

post.description: Customer role only. One-shot transition; the row is never deleted. Story E8-S3 AC2. AC-07.

409.description: Already accepted or dismissed; resolved_at is unchanged (E8-S3 AC4)

error.message: This recommendation has already been resolved.

post.description: Customer role only. One-shot transition; the row is never deleted. Story E8-S3 AC3. AC-07.

get.summary: List all customers with their current risk band
get.description: Advisor role only. Story E9-S3 AC1.

get.summary: Customer drill-in: holdings, goals, allocation, override history
get.description: Advisor role only. Single call so the drill-in view needs no fan-out. Story E9-S3 AC2.

post.summary: Override a customer's risk band with a mandatory reason
post.description: Advisor role only. Inserts an AdvisorOverride AND a new RiskBandAssignment in one transaction, plus one AuditLogEntry. Stories E9-S1, E9-S2, E9-S3. AC-09.

201.description: Override recorded and new band assigned

409.description: Customer has no prior RiskBandAssignment, so previous_band cannot be established

error.message: Customer has no risk-band assignment to override.

422.description: Missing or empty reason - nothing is written (E9-S2 AC2)

error.message: A reason is required for a risk-band override.

post.summary: Log a manual recommendation against a customer
post.description: Advisor role only. Persisted as an AuditLogEntry with entity_type=ManualRecommendation - no separate table (system-design.md 6.4). Fields: customer_id (path), advisor_id (JWT sub), note (required), created_at (server). Story E9-S3 AC4.

example.note: Recommended increasing cash weighting ahead of the client's Q4 liquidity need.
Recommended increasing cash weighting ahead of the client's Q4 liquidity need.

422.description: note missing, empty, whitespace-only, or longer than 2000 characters

error.message: A note is required.

post.summary: Advance the simulated price feed by one day
post.description: Admin role only. Manual trigger; no scheduler. Single transaction: NAV insert, holding revaluation, drift, goal snapshots, rebalancing evaluation. Stories E6-S2, E6-S4, E7-S3, E8-S2.

409.description: The simulated day has already been advanced; no duplicate NAV rows (E6-S4 AC4)

error.message: The simulated day has already been advanced.

get.summary: All RiskBandRule versions, active and superseded
get.description: Admin role only. Includes option point values. Ordered by version ascending. Story E10-S4 AC5.

questions.text: What is your investment time horizon?

post.summary: Publish a new immutable RiskBandRule version
post.description: Admin role only. version is server-assigned as max(version)+1. Prior active row is deactivated. Stories E10-S1, E10-S2, E10-S3. AC-10.

questions.text: What is your investment time horizon?

422.description: Fewer than 6 questions, or invalid scoring bands

error.message: A questionnaire must contain at least 6 questions.

get.summary: All AllocationTemplate versions, active and superseded
get.description: Admin role only. Ordered by risk_band then version ascending. Superseded versions remain fully queryable, supporting in-flight pinning. Story E10-S3 AC5.

post.summary: Publish a new immutable AllocationTemplate version
post.description: Admin role only. Percentages must sum to exactly 100 (checked as 10000 basis points, no tolerance). version is server-assigned. Stories E5-S1, E10-S2, E10-S3. AC-02, AC-10.

422.description: Percentages do not sum to exactly 100, or an allocation entry is invalid. Nothing is written.

error.message: Allocation percentages must sum to exactly 100.

get.description: Admin role only. Ordered by code ascending. Story E10-S4 AC4.

post.description: Admin role only. Duplicate code returns 409. Stories E10-S2 AC5, E10-S3 AC3.

error.message: An asset class with this code already exists.

patch.summary: Update an asset class's code or name
patch.description: Admin role only. Historical AllocationTemplate rows reference asset_class_id, so a rename never rewrites a published template (E10-S1 AC4). There is no delete endpoint.

get.description: Admin role only. Resolves BRD 13 open question on threshold storage (system-design.md 6.1).

post.summary: Publish a new immutable drift-threshold version
post.description: Admin role only. threshold_bps is an integer in basis points (500 = 5.00%) so the published value is exact (NFR-01). Existing pending recommendations are unaffected.

get.description: Compliance role only. Read-only by construction: no write method is registered on this path, so POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE return 405 (E3-S3 AC3). Stories E3-S1, E3-S3, E3-S4. NFR-02.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound; the whole day is included.

200.description: Matching audit entries, ordered by timestamp ascending

405.description: A write method was attempted on /api/audit (E3-S3 AC3)

error.message: The audit log is read-only.

bearerAuth.description: Single 60-minute HS256 access token. Claims: sub, role, exp, iat, and customer_id for the customer role. No refresh-token flow (system-design.md 6.2).

error.message: Authentication required.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but the role is not permitted for this endpoint (NFR-04)

error.message: Your role may not perform this action.

NotFound.description: Resource absent, or not visible to this actor

error.message: Resource not found.
This action conflicts with the current state.

VersionConflict.description: A concurrent publish already claimed the next version number; no silent overwrite (BRD 11)

error.message: Another publish already created this version.

ValidationError.description: Body or parameters are well-formed but semantically invalid; nothing is written

error.message: Request failed validation.

BadQueryParameter.description: A query parameter could not be parsed or is outside its allowed set

error.message: Invalid query parameter.

Money.description: Fixed-point money as a decimal STRING with exactly 2 decimals (NFR-01). Never a JSON number.

Percent.description: Fixed-point percentage as a decimal STRING with exactly 2 decimals. May be negative for drift (NFR-01).

Units.description: Fixed-point unit quantity as a decimal STRING with exactly 4 decimals (NFR-01).

Horizon.description: Derived from target_date: SHORT < 3 years, MEDIUM 3-7 years, LONG > 7 years.

message.description: Human-readable message. Never contains PII or credential material (NFR-03).

QuestionOptionPublic.description: Customer-facing option. points is deliberately omitted so the band cannot be reverse-engineered.

answers.description: Exactly one entry per question in the active questionnaire.

template_version.description: AC-10 traceability to the immutable published template.

as_of_date.description: Null when the customer holds nothing.

percent_complete.description: From the latest GoalProgressSnapshot; null before the first snapshot. Capped at 200.00.

target_date.description: Must be in the future (E7-S2 AC2).

recommendation_id.description: Public identifier used in paths; the internal row id is never exposed.

threshold_bps.description: The threshold version in force when this recommendation was generated.

email.description: Customers have no name field; email is the display identifier (data-models.md 1.1).

allocation.description: Null when the customer has no RiskBandAssignment.

reason.description: Mandatory (BRD 5.1). Empty or whitespace-only is rejected with 422.

assignment_id.description: The new RiskBandAssignment row created by this override.

note.description: The only body field. customer_id comes from the path, advisor_id from the JWT, created_at from the server (system-design.md 6.4).

bands.description: Contiguous, non-overlapping integer ranges covering the full achievable point span (NFR-01).

RiskBandRulePublishRequest.description: version is server-assigned as max(version)+1 and is rejected if supplied.

allocations.description: Percentages must sum to exactly 100 (10000 basis points). No tolerance (AC-02).

threshold_bps.description: Basis points. 500 = 5.00%. Integer keeps the value exact (NFR-01).

entity_id.description: Soft reference - an integer id or a recommendation_id UUID, as a string.

details_json.description: Ids, enums and version numbers only - no raw PII or position values (NFR-03). Sole exception: ManualRecommendation entries carry the advisor's note.
